title: Chaat Pe Panther
style: Phonk with a panther swagger and North Indian street-comedy bounce, around 92 BPM with swung trap hats, grave sub slides, dhol snaps, tumbi twang, shehnai licks, and harmonium color; verse rides beatbox and cheeky lead phrases, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and vocal percussion, chorus hits with gang backing singers and chant replies. Doubled lead, call-and-response ad-libs, short delay throws, mouth-drums, warm analog grit, punchy and dusty mix., comedy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Bum-bum, tsk-tsk
Aah, oye
Panther on the chaat pe
(oye) (oye)

[Verse 1]
Jutti pe dhool, par style clean
Nazar meri tip-top, hush, mean
Lassi in hand, main scene ka king
Beatbox karta, phir harmonium sing
(haan) (haan)
Gali mein taali, munda says "bro"
Main bolun "sí, yaar", then take it slow
Dhol ke thappad, tumbi ka flex
Phonk wali चाल, par local text

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up, baby, सुन
Panther ne kiya gun-gun
Side mein हँसी, front mein धuaan
Main laaya naya show yahan
(hey) (hey)
Piche se aaye, sing along crew
One-two, three-four, kya kare tu?

[Chorus]
Chaat pe panther
Chaat pe panther
Oye, ven aquí
Chaat pe panther
Chaat pe panther
Bum-bum, papi
(Chaat pe panther)
(Chaat pe panther)

[Verse 2]
Rickshaw se nikal, thoda swag mode
Golgappa crunch, and I stay bold
Mastaani aankh, par prank full load
Sabne kaha "boss", I said "make it gold"
(¡vamos!)
Shehnai cry, then the bass go low
Clap-clap tight, let the whole lane know
Meri team sab singer, saath mein line
Each one backin', making my shine
(haan ji) (oho)

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up, baby, सुन
Panther ne kiya gun-gun
Side mein हँसी, front mein धuaan
Main laaya naya show yahan
(hey) (hey)
Piche se aaye, sing along crew
One-two, three-four, kya kare tu?

[Chorus]
Chaat pe panther
Chaat pe panther
Oye, ven aquí
Chaat pe panther
Chaat pe panther
Bum-bum, papi
(Chaat pe panther)
(Chaat pe panther)

[Bridge]
[Beatbox break]
Bum-ka, tsk-ka, bum-ka
Harmonium बोले, "sun na"
Main hilaun bhangra, they freeze, then laugh
Panther ka prank hai half and half
(ayyy)
Dhol meri pulse, tumbi meri grin
Spanish mein bolun, "dale", फिर spin
North side messy, but the groove stay tight
Ek hi jhatka, and we own the night

[Final Chorus]
Chaat pe panther
Chaat pe panther
Oye, ven aquí
Chaat pe panther
Chaat pe panther
Bum-bum, papi
(Chaat pe panther)
(Chaat pe panther)
